name: Gina Krog
notes: Rich gas by its own 20-inch line to Sleipner A (SODIR pipeline register). Capacity: the highest month of SODIR net gas, Sep 2024 to Aug 2026; position: SODIR facility register

name: Ivar Aasen
notes: Oil and gas to the Edvard Grieg platform for processing, gas on through the Utsira High line to SAGE. Capacity: the highest month of SODIR net gas, Sep 2024 to Aug 2026

name: Dvalin
notes: Subsea field; the well stream goes to Heidrun's dedicated Dvalin gas module, and the gas is exported via Polarled to Nyhamna. Capacity: the highest month of SODIR net gas, Sep 2024 to Aug 2026

name: Dvalin tie-in (Polarled)
notes: DVALIN PLEM in SODIR's facility register, on the Polarled route: where Dvalin's gas from Heidrun joins Polarled

name: Valhall
notes: Gas is sent via Norpipe to Emden; oil and NGL go to the Ekofisk Centre. Includes Hod, processed on Valhall. Capacity: the highest month of SODIR net gas (Valhall plus Hod), Sep 2024 to Aug 2026; position: Valhall PH

name: Jotun FPSO (Balder area)
notes: The Jotun FPSO processes Ringhorne and excess Balder gas and exports rich gas via Statpipe (norskpetroleum.no, Jotun and Balder). Capacity: the highest month of SODIR net gas from Balder and Jotun, Sep 2024 to Aug 2026

name: Jotun tie-in (Statpipe)
notes: JOTUN T in SODIR's facility register (Statpipe): on Heimskringla's Draupner leg, about 11 km south of the Heimskringla T

name: Martin Linge
notes: Rich gas to the Frigg UK pipeline (FUKA) and on to the SEGAL terminal at St Fergus. Capacity: the highest month of SODIR net gas, Sep 2024 to Aug 2026

name: FUKA tie-in (Frigg TP1)
notes: FRIGG TP1-Y in SODIR's facility register: the end of the Martin Linge gas line, where it joins the Frigg UK System (FUKA) at the old Frigg TP1 bypass

name: Mariner
notes: UK heavy-oil field (first oil August 2019; operated by Adura since 1 Dec 2025, https://www.equinor.com/energy/mariner). It takes gas: a 6-inch, 33 km import line from a tee on Vesterled (NSTA PL3768) feeds its power generation. No supply in the model and not an exit

name: Mariner tie-in (Vesterled)
notes: NSTA PL3917, the Mariner spool at the Vesterled tee: where Mariner's gas import line leaves Heimskringla's St Fergus leg

name: Grane
notes: Oil field that takes gas for injection through the 18-inch Grane gas pipeline from the Heimdal riser (SODIR pipeline register, in service). SODIR records no net gas sales from Grane (Sep 2024 to Aug 2026), so it is no supply in the model and not an exit; oil goes to Sture
